# Code of Conduct

## Our pledge

We are committed to making participation in **My Connection** a welcoming, respectful, and harassment-free experience for everyone.

We welcome contributions from people of all backgrounds and levels of experience.

## Our standards

Examples of behavior that contribute to a positive environment include:

- Being respectful and considerate.
- Giving and accepting constructive feedback.
- Focusing on what is best for the project and its community.
- Being open to different perspectives and experiences.
- Assuming good intentions while remaining mindful of impact.

Unacceptable behavior includes:

- Harassment, discrimination, or personal attacks.
- Trolling, insulting, or derogatory comments.
- Unwelcome sexual attention or other inappropriate behavior.
- Publishing private information without permission.
- Any other conduct that would reasonably be considered inappropriate in a professional community.

## Enforcement responsibilities

Project maintainers are responsible for clarifying and enforcing the standards of acceptable behavior.

They may take appropriate and fair corrective action in response to behavior they consider inappropriate, threatening, offensive, or harmful.

## Scope

This Code of Conduct applies within project spaces, including issues, pull requests, discussions, and other project-related communication.

It may also apply to public spaces when an individual is representing the project or its community.

## Enforcement

Instances of abusive, harassing, or otherwise unacceptable behavior may be reported to the project maintainers.

Reports will be reviewed and investigated fairly and, when appropriate, confidentially.

## Attribution

This Code of Conduct is adapted from the
[Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/),
version 2.1.
